documents.title: Tier Configuration
documents.description: Single source of truth: 6 tiers, 31 sub-labels, ~104 sender + ~81 subject rules, settings (15-min classify, 30-day triage). Backed up to config.json.bak on every save.

documents.title: Dashboard Backend
documents.description: Flask app on port 8550. Tier designer + CRUD, Apps Script generator, filter/label/cleanup/migration APIs, OAuth flows (Gmail + Apps Script). Desktop tool — not NSSM.

documents.title: Generated Apps Script
documents.description: The deployable classifier: TIER_RULES + classifyMessage_, classifyNewEmails (15-min), triageStaleInbox (daily 1 AM), setupTriggers, dryRun. Auto-generated from config.json — do not edit by hand.

documents.title: Label Creator
documents.description: Builds the full colored tier label tree in Gmail via the labels API. Idempotent; uses Gmail's fixed 9-color palette.

documents.title: Filter Compiler
documents.description: config_to_filters() turns tier rules into native Gmail filters (senders/subjects batched into OR queries; add label + skip inbox). CLI: --dry-run / --list / --clear.

documents.title: Migration & Cleanup
documents.description: Move messages from legacy/retired labels into the new tier tree; rename old T0-T5 tiers to the 1-6 scheme; repair retired labels.

documents.title: Extension Manifest
documents.description: Manifest V3, v1.2.1. permissions, oauth2 (gmail.labels/modify/settings.basic + contacts), host_permissions, content script on mail.google.com, side panel, options page.

documents.title: Background Service Worker
documents.description: MV3 module worker: cross-browser OAuth, resilient gmailFetch, four AI provider adapters, aiTriageBatch classification, chrome.alarms job, diagnostic logger.

documents.title: Side Panel UI

documents.title: Gmail Content Script
